name: OTPField
summary: One box per character, for a verification code the user types or pastes.

a11y.apg: none: the practice adopted is one labelled input per character with autocomplete="one-time-code", which is what lets the phone offer the SMS code
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 22/08/2026. ArrowUp and Home move focus between the character boxes and were missing here. Note the measurement only works on a field that already has content: an empty OTP field pins focus to the first empty box by construction — that is where you must type — and no arrow moves anywhere. Measuring it pristine measured a state in which almost nothing can happen.

props.name: length
props.description: REQUIRED. How many characters the code has. Without it the field cannot know when it is complete.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. The whole code as one string, not one value per box.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every character, including when a full code is pasted at once.

props.name: mask
props.description: Hides the characters, the way a password does.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group — what the code is for.

props.name: disabled / required
props.description: Standard form states, forwarded to every box.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the focusable control, which is what a <label htmlFor> has to point at. Generated when you do not pass one.
